'''Tower 14''' was a communications [[Antenna/Legends|antenna]] located in [[Base Tekar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]]. During an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] infiltration into the facility, the [[operative]]s scaled Tower 14 and then used [[Tube-Launched Grapple]]s to fire [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hooks]] from the tower to the roof of the base.
